problem: Неверное время: «would have entered / would have cooked» (условное прошедшее) вместо простого condicional; «- ía», «" oficina "»
fix: Compare two tasks: "You would go into the office." / "I would cook at home tonight." The ending -ía and its personal variants carry the meaning of "would." Key word: "oficina" — office.
State what someone would do under the right circumstances, without turning a possibility into a promise. The ending -ía and its personal variants convey the meaning of "would."

problem: Во всех заметках разорванный дефис «The ending - ía»
fix: Key form: <форма главы>. The ending -ía and its personal variants convey the meaning "would".
Vivía — "used to live," the stem is viv-. Viviría — "would live," the whole stem vivir- is visible. Look not only at -ía, but also at the r before it.

problem: «The face determines the wish-fulfiller» — «лицо» переведено как face (нужно grammatical person); «normal - ar», «- er /- ir»
fix: Regular -ar verbs take e, es, e, emos, éis, en: hablar → hable. -er/-ir verbs take a, as, a, amos, áis, an: abrir → abra. The person of the verb is set by whoever is to do the wished-for action.
